title: Birthday Reminder List
description: Never miss a birthday: names and dates with days-until countdowns, next upcoming birthday highlighted, saved in your browser.
howto: Add each person with their name and birth date.
The list shows their upcoming birthday, turning age and days until.
The next upcoming birthday is highlighted at the top.
Everything is saved in your browser automatically.

faqs.a: From today to the next occurrence of the birthday — this year's date if it is still ahead, otherwise next year's. Leap-day birthdays (Feb 29) are shown on Feb 28 in non-leap years.
In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool — it stays on this device and browser.
No — this is a static page tool with no background notifications. Check the list weekly, or keep the tab bookmarked.
